name: python-max-subarray
title: Maximum Subarray
blurb: the largest contiguous sum of small integers: the answer equals brute-force enumeration on every seeded instance, the chosen subarray is witnessed, and oversized or malformed inputs are named, never measured.
default_description: A maximum subarray solver whose total equals brute-force enumeration on every small list, whose witness names the contiguous slice, and whose audit reports any mismatch.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: the largest contiguous sum is found by carrying the running total
